environment: Unity 2022.3.15f1 playable ad project (q07 mukbang ASMR, Playworks UPP 7.2.0). Unity Editor is controlled through UnityMCP tools.
Git remote is GitHub (usagihehe/q07-mukbang-asmr-ply). Main branch: main, working branch: ply. Commit locally only, never push unless asked.
allow: Running .claude/scripts/check-compile.sh or dotnet build on the project's csproj files
UnityMCP read-only tools and refresh_unity / read_console
soft_deny: git push, git reset --hard, git checkout -- on files, or deleting branches
Deleting files or folders under Assets/
Changing Packages/manifest.json or adding/removing Unity packages
Saving scenes or prefabs through UnityMCP
hard_deny: Reading, copying or uploading signing credentials or API keys
Sending project source or assets to any external service

hooks.command: cat >/dev/null || true; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && code-review-graph update --skip-flows --repo "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || true
cat >/dev/null || true; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && code-review-graph status --repo "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || echo 'Not a git repo, skipping'
